subject: Manager review requested for BF-ENH-0004 executable enhancement hardening
body: Review BF-ENH-0004 under RECURSIVE_CROSS_PROJECT_ENHANCEMENT_V1. The foreign Intercommunications Enhancements source remains strictly read-only. Assess whether its executable controls materially improve BenefitFlow's existing tools/recursive_enhancement_cycle.py beyond current policy enforcement, especially peer revision pinning, traversal-safe peer path validation, source-content SHA-256 provenance, deterministic candidate identity, local project-root enforcement, no-overwrite collision failure, bounded artifacts/recursion, and durable cycle persistence ordering. Classify SAFE_REUSABLE, ADAPT_REQUIRED, CONFLICT, DUPLICATE, OUT_OF_SCOPE, or SENSITIVE_OR_PROHIBITED; include regression, rollback, package, and recovery consequences. Do not graft or promote the candidate into accepted project truth. Return a recommendation to Primary. No new Research slot is required for this review unless separately authorized.
